crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin steadies near $74K after the hot-CPI selloff
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $73,000 after October CPI came in at 0.4% versus 0.3% expected, then bounced back toward $74,000. Traders are watching the 200-day moving average around $73,200 and the $72,500 level.

crypto_headlines.title: Square turns on Bitcoin payments for about 4 million US merchants
crypto_headlines.summary: Square completed its Bitcoin payments rollout on Nov 10, enabling Lightning payments by QR code for about four million eligible US merchants, with zero fees through 2026 and an option to keep proceeds in bitcoin. New York sellers are excluded.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $201 million in net outflows on Nov 9, with BlackRock's IBIT alone losing $213.2 million, while Ethereum ETFs shed $184.6 million the same day.

crypto_headlines.title: USDT supply shrinks at its fastest 60-day pace since 2022
crypto_headlines.summary: CryptoQuant data shows Tether's USDT supply fell about $6.6 billion over 60 days, and total stablecoin market cap slipped to about $290 billion, signaling tighter liquidity.

crypto_headlines.title: Glassnode: 35.4% of Bitcoin supply has exposed public keys
crypto_headlines.summary: About 7.12 million BTC sit at addresses with visible public keys, mostly from address reuse and exchange wallets, reviving talk about long-term quantum-resistance upgrades.

crypto_headlines.title: Pyth priced 88.5% of a record October in RWA perps
crypto_headlines.summary: RWA perpetuals hit an all-time high of $829.4B in October volume, and Pyth priced 88.5% ($734.3B) of it.

doginal_news.title: Registration opens for the first official DDLTCG Championship
doginal_news.summary: Legends TCG opened registration for its first official championship. Top 16 advance to the live Miami finals on Dec 8, and the champion wins rare Victorious Gary promos, a Doginal Dog NFT and Rise of the Pack boxes.

doginal_news.title: Card spotlight: Houdini, Epic Wizard
doginal_news.summary: Houdini is a 4-mana 2/2 in Rise of the Pack that summons up to two Creatures costing 2 or less straight from your deck.

doginal_news.title: Community thanks the team for replacing lost NFTs
doginal_news.summary: Holders thanked Bark, Shield and GodsBurnt for replacing NFTs from their own collection after the recent loss.

doginal_news.title: Marketplace tutorial for new holders
doginal_news.summary: A walkthrough of the official Doginal Dogs Marketplace for buying, selling and viewing all 10,000 dogs inscribed on Dogecoin.

doginal_news.title: Earn is live on Solana, powered by Pyth
doginal_news.summary: Pyth announced Earn is live, letting users put idle stablecoins to work on Solana.

doginal_news.title: A new big wave lands today
doginal_news.summary: Pyth teased a big new drop for today, and PIRB followed up with a one-word reminder: Today.

notes: No new floor or sales update from the Doginal Dogs account in the last day.
